title: Clearing the gates
message: Every held item in the Inbox has its own button; every clearing act moves the article at once; Advance anyway is recorded
audience: Editors and admins working the Inbox

scenes.headline: Clearing the *gates.*
scenes.sub: Questions, claims, images and held articles, from the Inbox.
scenes.narration: Review is what still needs a person after the engine has done what it can. Everything here is in the Inbox, each card with its own button. This video shows how to clear each kind of hold, and what happens the moment you do.

scenes.headline: Asked once. Answer in your own *words.*
scenes.narration: Questions only you can answer sit at the top. Each names the article and the sentence that needs your knowledge. Answer inline, in your own words. The answer is woven into the article and banked to the expert profile, so it is asked once. Answer all clears the card in one go. Dismiss, with an optional why, if the question does not apply.

callouts.label: Banked
callouts.title: To the expert profile, so it is asked once

scenes.headline: Verify with a link, or *drop it.*
scenes.narration: Claims with no source. The writer marked a factual claim and live search could not find a source an independent judge agreed with. Two buttons. Verify: paste a link that genuinely supports the sentence. Drop: the marker and the record go, and you edit the sentence in the article if it should go too. A claim needs a live-search key to be sourced automatically; give it one sweep, then decide.

callouts.label: Needs
callouts.title: A live-search key (Tavily or Serper) to source claims on its own

scenes.headline: The brake already *spent its renders.*
scenes.narration: Images that need your eye. The vision model found cut-off text, a wrong brand name or a glitch, and after two failed renders it stopped spending. Approve the image as it is, or open the article and pick or upload another. The brake means auto-review has already spent up to three renders on it.

callouts.label: The brake
callouts.title: failed renders, then it asks a person

scenes.headline: The failing check is named on the *card.*
scenes.narration: Held articles name the failing check on the card. Open the article and the Gates sidebar links to the tab where you fix it. An admin who wants it out regardless has Advance anyway: an optional reason, then it moves to final approval now, and who, when and why are recorded on the article and in the audit log.

callouts.label: Held
callouts.title: The failing check is named on the card

callouts.label: Advance anyway
callouts.title: Admin only · optional reason · recorded: who, when, why

scenes.headline: Approve, or request changes with a *note.*
scenes.narration: Two more tabs under Publish. Approvals lists social posts waiting for an admin when the approval workflow is on: approve, or request changes with a note for the author. Audit scans the archive and recommends what to refresh, merge or retire, so it never goes stale. Run it monthly.

scenes.headline: Nothing waits for the next *sweep.*
scenes.narration: Every clearing act moves the article at once. Answer a question, verify or drop a claim, approve an image, and if that was the last thing holding it, the article advances to final approval immediately. Nothing waits for the next sweep. Work the Inbox top to bottom until the header count reads zero.

callouts.text: Every clearing act moves the article at once.

scenes.narration: Answer, verify or drop, approve or replace, and advance when you must. Next: publishing.
